newsitem.title: SPAIN: Peseta debt/interbank market midday report.
newsitem.headline: Peseta debt/interbank market midday report.

text.p: Spanish government bonds extended initial losses after the Treasury auction on Tuesday, but the long bond future soon recovered from lows, dealers said.

"The amount allotted was higher than expected, and so the marginal yields (on three- and 10-year bonds) were both a bit higher than the corresponding ones in the secondary market," a dealer in Madrid said.
But he added that the September contract quickly recovered after touching a low at 116.22.
Dealers said the focus would be on the U.S. Federal Reserve's FOMC meeting later on Tuesday.
